channelTitle: Grandma June's other go-to when a cold hits, besides soup
hook: When chicken soup isn't on hand, a warm bowl of oatmeal does the job just as well.
remedy: A warm bowl of plain oatmeal is an old comfort-food remedy for when a cold makes eating feel like a chore, easy on the throat and gentle on the stomach.
steps: Cook oats with water or milk until soft and warm
Stir in a little honey or a pinch of cinnamon if you'd like
Eat slowly while it's still warm, letting it soothe your throat
caution: Honey isn't safe for babies under 1. See a doctor if cold symptoms last more than ten days or get worse.
cta: Soup or oatmeal, what's your comfort food when you're feeling under the weather? Tell Grandma June below.
